original.statement: When Dex is used, the sub claim is now overridden with federated_claims.user_id.

decision.reason: [ev-35cf1ed1a407] says that when Dex is used, the token's sub claim is now overridden with federated_claims.user_id. That fits protocol-behavior: the identity-claim handling changes while the configuration stays the same. The proposed name is short kebab-case built only from the evidence's own key words. behavior-changed is the right change type because no config key, default or value literal is named. Only the one-line commit title is available, so the choice of subject family is a judgement call rather than something the evidence states outright.
